Charlotte County’s FREE
Shared-Ride, Curb-to-Curb
Transportation Service
-----------------------------------------
Reservations
Trips are first-come, first-served.
To request a trip, download the
Charlotte Rides app
or call 941.575.4000, option 1.
Phone reservations are taken
Monday through Friday,
from 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
Please be ready to answer
the following:
First and last name
Date of travel
Number of passengers and names
Requested destination arrival time
Destination name and address
Pickup location
Passengers will receive a 30-minute
pickup window based upon the
requested destination arrival time.
Reservations must be canceled at least one hour
before the scheduled pickup window or they will
be recorded as a “Missed Trip.”

Please see the Passenger Rules and Regulations and
Missed Trip Policy at CharlotteCountyFL.gov/transit.

Charlotte Rides vehicles are fully accessible, with ramps that make it
easy to board in a wheelchair, on a scooter, or with a walker.
